mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates continued accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 2.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals economic weakness and potential recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 4.0% is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index level exceeds 255.0 and FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5%, the market interprets this as the Fed being behind the curve, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as rate cut expectations rise.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (CPIAUCSL > 255.0 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines in a high-growth expansion regime, or the Rank IC for INDPRO decline in high-growth expansion is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates higher corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods with rising HOUST are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 261.77) signals a potential shift to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 261.77, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 261.77 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (HOUST < 1150.0 and INDPRO < 105.0) fails to produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth expansion regime, a decline in residential sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS < 490000 in a high-growth expansion regime, or the Rank IC for RSAFS < 490000 in high-growth expansion is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
